subject: MAP cadence: readiness sprint & acceptance runway
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nexlith.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP cadence: readiness sprint & acceptance runway

Hi Samir / Nexlith POC team,

Following up from yesterday's kickoff, here's an updated weekly checkpoint note and the lightweight readiness sprint I propose for the POC acceptance window. Attached: POC_Eval_Criteria_v2.xlsx (updated pass/fail rows and sampling plan).

Summary (this week's sprint):
- Goal: reach evaluation parity on key queries (search-relevance + latency under 120ms p50) and finalize data retention config.
- Critical acceptance gates: functional tests green, no regressions on the 50-core prompt set, and SOC evidence for data handling in place.
- Proposed acceptance runway: initial canary on Mon 4/20, expanded trial 4/22-4/28, final sign-off 4/30.

Owners and asks this week:
- Samir: provide SOC point-of-contact and target date to share questionnaire responses (blocked item).
- Rishi: allocate a second dedicated queue for the quantized variant and run nightly evals (Rishi owns).
- Hannah: coordinate security scoping and confirm KMS/HSM requirements with Nexlith security team.
- Connor: share the SOW draft for any procurement constraints so procurement can start the PO loop.

Key notes: trying to keep the ramp short but realistic — if SOC evidence slips, we should shift the expanded trial by a few business days rather than cut corners. Please reply with confirmations and any blockers by EOD Monday.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: POC_Eval_Criteria_v2.xlsx

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nexlith.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nexlith POC <poc@nexlith.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP cadence: readiness sprint & acceptance runway

Marissa — thanks for the clear plan and the spreadsheet. Quick update from my side: our security team just kicked off an internal SOC2 readiness sprint and they want to review any third-party data handling docs before we expand the trial. That will likely push the evidence handoff by 2–3 business days. I attached what we can share now (security_questionnaire_responses.pdf) — it's the internal Q/A we've run; some items are redacted.

Proposed adjustment: keep the canary on 4/20 (we want to sanity-check latency and relevance) but move the broader trial start to 4/24 and final sign-off to 5/4. If Redwood can provide a short note on where KV cache data is persisted and retention TTLs, I can try to accelerate the SOC review.

Also: procurement is waiting on an SOW and a rough estimate for committed throughput for the dedicated queue (we should surface the expected tokens/day so they can size the PO).

—Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform, Nexlith Systems
samir.patel@nexlith.com

Attachment: security_questionnaire_responses.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@nexlith.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP cadence: readiness sprint & acceptance runway

Thanks Samir — I saw the questionnaire. Quick operational notes and actions from the infra side:

- I'll spin up a second dedicated queue for the quantized model tonight; target first-night run of the full 50-core prompt set is 4/19.
- I'll export a short one-page note on where the KV cache and prefix cache persist (local ephemeral on the worker + optional S3 backup for checkpointing) and include the TTLs; Marissa, I can drop that into your drive link.
- Throughput/estimates: for the dedicated queue we expect 4–6M tokens/day at baseline with burst capacity to 10M tokens/day — I'll add a small buffer in the SOW draft so procurement has a conservative number.

Action items (owner / due):
- Rishi: run nightly full eval and post summary to drive (due 2026-04-19).
- Rishi: KV cache persistence note (due 2026-04-19).
- Connor: circulate SOW draft with throughput numbers (Connor owns, draft attached once ready).
- Hannah: attach security contact notes and confirm whether KMS/HSM is required (due 2026-04-20).

If SOC review slips further, I'm okay with the expanded trial moving out a week — we should keep the canary as Samir suggested.
